## Role and prompt

Perform a defensive review for SQL parameter binding, strict inputs, unsafe DOM writes, future-price leakage and localhost binding. Correct confirmed issues and rerun related checks. Record findings and test evidence in docs/SECURITY.md.

Use docs/SPEC.md as the source of truth. Report files changed, verification and blockers briefly.
